text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fenomeno-san.
We've hit a dead end on our own.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Please—I beg of you, investigate this.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
!? I don't know the circumstances, but—
Understood! I will give it everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
......Curry and... pudding?
What on earth is this?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You made it, Fenomeno!
Sorry to trouble you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You probably know this already, but...
our cafeteria has limited-time menu items, right?
A special dish that's even fancier and tastier than usual!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We've been trying to recreate that flavor.
We've been giving it our all forever, but it's so tough!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Even with our culinary pride, we can't pinpoint it, but there's definitely a hidden aromatic accent in there!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...I see. And so the arrow of choice fell
upon me for my keen nose?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm~! The curry's a mystery, and the pudding's a mystery too!
I wonder what that final pinch of something is~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno-san! Please lend us a hand with that sharp nose of yours!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Helping people in need through an investigation.
That is certainly...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This is Officer Fenomeno's duty, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I will definitely
track down the culprit... er, secret ingredient!!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, I'll go first!
It's the 'Super Energetic! Keema Curry'☆
I wonder what this aroma is?"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Understood, sir! Now then—forensics time!
*sniff* *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!? Pungent stimulation detected!
Ingredients differing from normal curry... I see!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: This is—sansho pepper!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A crisp, zesty spice is surely
the very source of vitality!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Awesome--!!
There was hidden sansho pepper in here~! Thank you~☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"From me, here is this—
the 'Cafeteria Special☆Pudding.'
We didn't have such sweetness back in my homeland."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. For now, let's do forensics here too!
*sniff sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
“—Hm? Fragrances from multiple locations, mixed together?
A more detailed analysis is required.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san! Could you please move
only the caramel sauce to a separate plate,
and not the pudding itself?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Sniff sniff, once more—... I knew it!
The sauce has that rich, traditional sweet aroma!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Forensic test results: It's mirin!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Mirin... Ah, I see!
That's where the gentle sweetness of the sauce comes from!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Well, that's splendid!
One good sniff and problem solved!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm! Sansho pepper♪ And mirin♪
Thanks to my nose, it's super buono☆

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Fenomeno.
I'd like to properly thank you for your help with the investigation next time.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No! Please pay it no mind!
This officer merely fulfilled her duty!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "We couldn't possibly. The three of us want to express our gratitude. For example... how would a thank-you gift like this be?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day at lunchtime, I spotted Fenomeno
holding a huge bento box.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Boss!!
Actually—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...And as a thank-you, they gave me this boxed lunch, sir!
choice_data_list: It'd be great if you could put that sense of smell to use in your own cooking.
Should I really have exposed the cafeteria's secret without permission?
Should I really have exposed the cafeteria's secret like that?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...And as a thank-you, they gave me this boxed lunch, sir!
choice_data_list: It'd be great if you could put that sense of smell to use in your own cooking.
Should I really have exposed the cafeteria's secret without permission?
Should I really have exposed the cafeteria's secret like that?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh!?
Th-That's true...!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
That was a complete blind spot!
I'll get right on it... so once it's perfected,
please be sure to give it a taste!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Please don't worry about that! Flash-san and the others
said they'd keep it a secret between the three of them!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"And what's more! Taking inspiration from the cafeteria's secret ingredient,
I'll be trying out a new recipe twist...
I am quite looking forward to it, sir!"
